messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick heads-up — TuringStore (renewal Q3) flagged a persistent tail latency spike after last week's model swap. p95 went from ~420ms -> ~680ms for API /v1/chat. Proactive suggestion: run a non-disruptive INT8 quantization trial + targeted routing split (10%) to us-east for 24h, with canary health checks (latency, error rate, a small eval set). Need SE + ML sign-off and enablement for the customer.

Raj (SE): +1. I can spin up the route and add fallback rules. Suggest name `turingstore-canary-quant`. Circuit: if p95 > 500ms or error_rate > 1% for 5m, auto-failover to baseline.

Raj (SE): Sample route config I’ll apply (simplified):
```json
{"routes": [{"name":"turingstore-canary-quant","match":{"customer_id":"turingstore","region":"us-east"},"traffic_split":{"quant-int8":0.10,"baseline":0.90},"health_checks":{"p95_ms":500,"error_rate":0.01}}]}
```

Lin (ML Eng): A few ML caveats — INT8 typically gives ~35–45% cost reduction and small latency wins, but rare prompt classes can show slight quality delta. We should run a 50-prompt evaluation (representative edge cases) during the canary and watch a semantic similarity metric (bert_sim). If semantic_match drops >2.5% vs baseline, revert. Also recommend enabling KV prefix caching (prefix_len=32) — that helps latency and reduces token work for repeated prompts.

Priya (Enablement): I’ll schedule a 30m enablement call with Jordan next Tue 10:00am PT to set expectations and walk through rollback. I’ll also deliver a short runbook with: canary timeline, health thresholds, how to request rollback, and how we’ll capture their qualitative feedback (2 quick survey Qs).

Victor (AE): Can someone produce a 1-pager (bulletized) I can share with the renewal exec? Focus: risk mitigation, expected cost delta, rollback plan, and monitoring.

OpsBot: deploybot: route `turingstore-canary-quant` created and staged -> applying canary at 10% traffic to `quant-int8` :white_check_mark:

Maya (CSM): Thanks — action items recap: Raj -> deploy canary + health checks; Lin -> run 50-prompt eval and post thresholds; Priya -> enablement + runbook; Victor -> renewal memo; I’ll follow up EOD and ping if any customer concern. :thumbsup:
